exposure: Bringing infant formula to the birth facility
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding for the first 3 days after birth (EBF3D)
cohort: 726 mothers with children aged 0-11 months in two provinces and one municipality in Vietnam
finding: Early initiation and exclusive breastfeeding were positively associated with immediate and uninterrupted skin-to-skin contact and negatively associated with cesarean birth, episiotomy, and bringing infant formula to the birth facility.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was negatively associated with both early initiation of breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding for the first 3 days after birth.
